name: A Little Witch's Wish
source:
Follow little Willow as she sets out on a fun, magical adventure to find a fallen shooting star! Willow's a sweet, curious little girl who lives a secret life of a witch. There are many untold stories and mysteries to uncover for those with a careful eye. And remember: your choices matter!

[From [url=https://fruitcustard.itch.io/a-little-witchs-wish]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随小威洛踏上有趣而神奇的冒险之旅，寻找一颗坠落的流星！威洛是一个可爱、好奇的小女孩，过着女巫的秘密生活。对于那些细心的人来说，有许多不为人知的故事和奥秘有待揭开。请记住：你的选择很重要！

[来自[url=https://fruitcustard.itch.io/a-little-witchs-wish]itch.io[/url]]
